problem: New product with no brand memory against an established energizer brand
strategic_decision: Name carrying a larger number (500 vs 115) that acts as a numeric anchor before any scientific comparison
lesson: Test what customers infer from a name, not only whether they like it; separate branding from misleading inference
evidence_type: Case material; product facts need independent verification

problem: Challenger cannot claim the leader's 'original foreign brand' attribute
strategic_decision: Own a relational meaning (the loyal friend who stands by you) instead of imitating the leader
lesson: If the competitor owns a truth you cannot take, own a different meaning; emotional metaphor is not a clinical claim

problem: Part of the market is not served by the core product
strategic_decision: Line extension, flanker brand and franchise extension (e.g. Cold & Flu, Sinus, Joint, Night)
lesson: Portfolio strength is retaining the customer when the need changes; judge by sell-out, repeat orders and cannibalisation, not sell-in

problem: Generic 'moisturiser' positioning in a crowded category
strategic_decision: Link the product to hypertensive patients on diuretics who suffer dryness (Problem -> User -> Product Relevance)
lesson: Before adding features, find the segment where the existing feature matters more
evidence_type: Case material; medical use needs clinical and regulatory verification

problem: Product defined only as a peeling agent
strategic_decision: Feature -> Mechanism -> Consequence -> User: reposition as a gateway that prepares skin for what is applied after it
lesson: Move from feature to mechanism to discover a new user; mechanism-based opportunities must pass clinical evidence and regulatory approval
evidence_type: Case material; absorption and therapeutic claims unverified

problem: Treating 'everyone who wants to lose weight' as the market
strategic_decision: Concentrated marketing on narrower segments by need, motive and context
lesson: Problem population is not an addressable segment; subtract those the product does not suit, cannot reach or may not be targeted
evidence_type: Case material; disease-segment links need verification

problem: All antibiotic messages talk about infections, use and dosage
strategic_decision: Shift from 'according to use' to 'according to user' (liver-safety angle)
lesson: When category messages converge on use, differentiate on the user; antibiotic positioning stays bound by rational-use principles
evidence_type: Case material; safety claims need label and clinical verification

problem: Sachet format, hot water and taste act as frictions in the cold-remedy market
strategic_decision: Occasion reframing toward snoring ('No More Snore'), also addressing the affected spouse
lesson: Test a new usage occasion before changing the product; a marketing insight is not a medical indication
evidence_type: Case material; new use is a hypothesis requiring evidence and regulatory approval

problem: Price signal inconsistent with the intended premium positioning
strategic_decision: Price increase as part of positioning
lesson: Price is part of the value argument but cannot compensate for weak real value; test changes gradually
evidence_type: Consulting case by Dr. Mostafa Nawareg; no independent sales data establishing causality

problem: Temptation to expand into every attractive market
strategic_decision: Long-term specialisation (insulin and diabetes since the 1920s; Novo and Nordisk merged in 1989)
lesson: Grow where accumulated capabilities give a stronger starting point (capability-adjacent growth)

problem: Head-to-head comparison against an entrenched, trusted market leader
strategic_decision: Reframe the choice from 'Who is better?' to 'Who is more appropriate?' (fly swatter vs hand grenade metaphor)
lesson: A challenger need not defeat the leader; it can stop the leader from being the automatic answer to every situation
evidence_type: Case material; reported first-month growth conflicts (300% vs 430%) and is unverified

problem: Defining the competitor as another real-estate project only
strategic_decision: Widen the competitive set to everything that competes for the customer's budget
lesson: Property may compete with cars, travel and other spending patterns

problem: Selecting customers by purchasing power only
strategic_decision: Targeting through everyday-life problems
lesson: Customer pain can become the basis for targeting and messaging

case_name: Wadi Degla - Kinda Alloush & Amr Youssef ad
problem: Attractive ad story without a clear reason to buy
strategic_decision: Link the creative to the property's benefit
lesson: Creativity does not compensate for a weak value proposition

problem: Communicating company information instead of customer benefit
strategic_decision: Translate the information into a value proposition
lesson: Customers want to know what they will get

problem: Reducing competition to price per square metre
strategic_decision: Build psychological, social and lifestyle value
lesson: Property carries meaning and identity, not only specifications

problem: Segmenting customers by income only
strategic_decision: Segment by household size and family life cycle
lesson: A change in the customer's life can change the product needed

problem: Markets, projects and customers differ
strategic_decision: Customise diagnosis and strategy for each project
lesson: No single real-estate strategy fits everyone

problem: Need for clearer marketing decisions
strategic_decision: Data- and analysis-based consulting
lesson: Shorter learning time and clearer decisions

problem: Large audience sees no value in a bank account; low banking literacy and trust
strategic_decision: Competitors cooperate to build the category
lesson: When the barrier is shared, market building is collective; competition starts at brand promise and experience

problem: Savings kept at home because cash under one's control feels safer
strategic_decision: Turn fear into a motive to deposit
lesson: Diagnose the belief that blocks account opening; move the customer from 'what could I lose?' to a simple safe next step
evidence_type: Campaign and date documented; impact not published

case_name: Banque Misr ATM that does not retain cards
problem: Card retention causes loss of access to money, calls and waiting
strategic_decision: Prevent the problem through design
lesson: Map moments of anxiety in the journey and prevent them by design before they reach the call centre

problem: Customers waiting on hold
strategic_decision: Give time back to the customer with a call-back option
lesson: Make the bank return to the customer; measure acceptance, answer rate, resolution time, abandonment and satisfaction

problem: CSR treated as a spending line
strategic_decision: Turn spending into measurable impact
lesson: Prove the size of change, not the size of spending: inputs -> activities -> outputs -> outcomes -> long-term impact

case_name: National Bank of Egypt & 'Al Abakera' (The Geniuses)
problem: Sponsorship bought as audience reach only
strategic_decision: Associate the brand with education and excellence
lesson: Sponsor a meaning, not just an audience; measure recall, correct attribution, target brand attributes and intent

case_name: 'I am a son of Egypt... I am against breaking' campaign
problem: Building an emotionally owned brand space
strategic_decision: Own a national emotional territory
lesson: Emotional ownership is measured by recall, attribute association, preference and behaviour, not song reach alone
evidence_type: Campaign documented; commercial impact not published

problem: Sports sponsorship without conversion
strategic_decision: Turn fans into product users
lesson: Design a path from fan to customer and separate the effects of sponsorship, offer and sales channels

problem: Competition in a highly similar product
strategic_decision: Rethink cost as part of strategy
lesson: Cost structure is part of strategy

problem: Imitation and escalating competition
strategic_decision: Manage innovation before sliding into a price war
lesson: Innovation can turn into a race

problem: Facing much larger competitors
strategic_decision: Change the competitive arena
lesson: Change the battlefield when its rules favour the giant

problem: Defining the competitor too narrowly
strategic_decision: Compete on need and occasion
lesson: Your competitor is not necessarily a similar drink

problem: Searching for new growth
strategic_decision: User x Need x Occasion
lesson: Growth may lie in the occasion, not the product

problem: Product profitability vs basket profitability
strategic_decision: Basket economics
lesson: You may lose on the product and win on the customer

problem: Distributor power within the channel
strategic_decision: Product adaptation and its effect on bargaining power
lesson: Product adaptation can protect the company's negotiating power
evidence_type: Field experience / educational case by Dr. Mostafa Nawareg

problem: Lack of growth capabilities
strategic_decision: Partner -> Platform -> Acquire
lesson: Growth through complementary capabilities

problem: Entering a new category quickly
strategic_decision: Buy a platform, capabilities and time
lesson: Acquisition can buy speed into a new category
